title: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not verify that a user is allowed to edit the…
description: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin versions before 6.8.11 contain a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify user permissions before modifying bidirectional relationship fields. This allows users with contributor-level access or higher to add or remove references to their own objects on posts, users, or terms they cannot normally edit.
